messages:
deploy-bot: Canary check: release=search-indexer chart=searcher-v4.0 found unexpected overlay annotation in 5/30 canary pods: `ingress.annotations.promote=true`. expected absent. severity=warn (soft block). command: `kubectl -n prod get deploy -l app=search-indexer -o jsonpath='{.items[*].metadata.annotations}'`
sam_eng: that annotation would flip traffic routing in our ingress controller. no wonder canary saw higher request rates and backend timeouts. who added it?
rui: it came from `team-search/canary-overlay.yaml` in the merge earlier today. the promoted chart 4.0 doesn't set that annotation by itself.
lina: change window is open until 19:30 UTC. options: 1) abort promotion, 2) promote but explicitly remove annotation via values/patch, 3) proceed but isolate canary. I'd vote for promote with patch to remove annotation and keep canary labeled for analysis.
sam_eng: concrete plan: helm upgrade search-release charts/searcher --namespace prod --version 4.0.0 --reuse-values --set ingress.annotations.promote="" --set imagePromotion.meta=manual-pin-2026-04-12. Also add a post-deploy job to clear any stray pod annotations.
rui: sketch of commands:
```bash
# promote but clear the annotation
helm upgrade search-release charts/searcher \
  --namespace prod --version 4.0.0 \
  --reuse-values \
  --set ingress.annotations.promote=\"\" \
  --set imagePromotion.meta=manual-pin-2026-04-12
# tag canary group for investigation
kubectl -n prod label deployment search-indexer release-type=canary --overwrite
# optional: ensure no pod-level annotations remain
kubectl -n prod get pods -l app=search-indexer -o name | xargs -n1 kubectl annotate --overwrite -n prod -l app=search-indexer ingress.annotations.promote-
```
sam_eng: rollback surface: `helm rollback search-release 9` to previous revision if pinned rollout shows issues. If canary continues to behave strangely, scale canary down: `kubectl -n prod scale deployment search-indexer --replicas=0 -l release-type=canary`.
lina: please capture in release notes and audit: mention manual annotation removal. We should also open RD-6002 to sync overlays and add overlay policy to prevent `ingress.annotations.promote` from being set by overlays unless approved.
deploy-bot: monitoring recommendation: create short watch for search-indexer: pod_startup>20s, request_5xx>0.5% sustained over 5m. Creating watch now.
rui: helm dry-run output shows annotation present only in canary overlay. helm template diff snippet:```diff
--- a/templates/ingress.yaml
+++ b/templates/ingress.yaml
@@
-  annotations:
-    kubernetes.io/ingress.class: nginx
+  annotations:
+    kubernetes.io/ingress.class: nginx
+    # removed for rollout
+    # ingress.annotations.promote: \"true\"
```
sam_eng: good catch. I'll create RD-6002 and add the blurb to release notes: "Cleared stray ingress.promote annotation from overlays; main rollout pinned to remove annotation; canary instances retained for investigation."
lina: @oncall-bot please add 40m watch for search-indexer after promote. :eyes:
deploy-bot: Watch scheduled: search-indexer-watch (40m). thresholds: pod_startup_latency>20s, request_5xx_rate>0.005, pod_restart_count>2.
sam_eng: executing promote now. will post completion timestamp + helm upgrade output.
rui: helm upgrade completed (dry-run then real): manifest diff shows annotation removed. pasted `helm template` diff above.
sam_eng: promote executed at 3971234580. Helm upgrade success, rollout completed. Canary label left on 5 pods running with old overlay (annotation present) for postmortem.
lina: monitoring stable so far. small spike in ingress latency during image pull, recovered. Keeping the watch until end of window.
release-manager: decision: proceed with pinned promote and retain canary pods for analysis. Action items: RD-6002 created and assigned to @rui and @sam_eng to add overlay policy and schedule follow-up; add one-line to release notes and audit log. Close thread after watch if no regressions. :white_check_mark:
